entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This civil revision has been preferred by the petitioner under Section 115 of CPC, 1908 against the order dated 12.12.2024 passed by the learned Member, MACT, District Badwani (M.P.), in MACC no.216/2024 whereby claim of respondents/claimants has been entertained despite not filing within six months of occurrence of the incident.

2. In a nutshell, the facts in brief are that a claim for compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 was filed on 03.05.2024 regarding the injuries occurred in motor vehicles accident dated 01.11.2023 alleging the application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that issue of limitation is under consideration before Hon'ble Apex Court for adjudication.
Therefore, Tribunal be directed not to pass final order in MACC No.216/2024.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and have perused the record.

5. In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioner, it is directed that Tribunal shall proceed with the case, but it shall not pass final order in the case, till disposal of the issue of limitation before the Hon'ble Apex Court.
